require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'digest'

module SecureUpload
  class EncryptionContext
    ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm'
    KEY_DERIVATION_ITERATIONS = 100_000

    attr_reader :master_key, :nonce_registry

    def initialize(master_secret)
      @master_key = derive_master_key(master_secret)
      @nonce_registry = NonceRegistry.new
      @cipher_pool = CipherPool.new(ALGORITHM)
    end

    def encrypt_upload(file_data, metadata)
      session = EncryptionSession.new(self, metadata)
      session.seal(file_data)
    end

    def decrypt_upload(sealed_payload)
      session = DecryptionSession.new(self)
      session.open(sealed_payload)
    end

    private

    def derive_master_key(secret)
      salt = Digest::SHA256.digest("SecureUpload::MasterKey::v2")
      OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(
        secret,
        salt: salt,
        iterations: KEY_DERIVATION_ITERATIONS,
        length: 32,
        hash: 'sha256'
      )
    end
  end

  class NonceRegistry
    def initialize
      @seen = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def register(nonce)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        hex = nonce.unpack1('H*')
        return false if @seen[hex]
        @seen[hex] = Time.now.to_i
        true
      end
    end

    def seen?(nonce)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @seen.key?(nonce.unpack1('H*'))
      end
    end
  end

  class CipherPool
    def initialize(algorithm)
      @algorithm = algorithm
    end

    def acquire
      OpenSSL::Cipher.new(@algorithm)
    end
  end

  class EncryptionSession
    def initialize(context, metadata)
      @context = context
      @metadata = metadata
      @session_key = derive_session_key(context.master_key, metadata)
    end

    def seal(plaintext)
      iv = generate_iv
      cipher = @context.instance_variable_get(:@cipher_pool).acquire
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = @session_key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.auth_data = build_aad

      ciphertext = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag

      @context.nonce_registry.register(iv)

      {
        'version' => 2,
        'iv' => Base64.strict_encode64(iv),
        'ciphertext' => Base64.strict_encode64(ciphertext),
        'tag' => Base64.strict_encode64(tag),
        'metadata' => @metadata
      }.to_json
    end

    private

    def generate_iv
      iv_material = SecureRandom.random_bytes(12)
      # Bind IV to upload metadata for domain separation
      bound = Digest::SHA256.digest(
        iv_material + @metadata.fetch('upload_id', '')
      )
      bound[0, 12]
    end

    def derive_session_key(master_key, metadata)
      context_string = "upload:#{metadata.fetch('upload_id', 'default')}"
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', master_key, context_string)
    end

    def build_aad
      "v2:#{@metadata.fetch('upload_id', '')}:#{@metadata.fetch('content_type', '')}"
    end
  end

  class DecryptionSession
    def initialize(context)
      @context = context
    end

    def open(sealed_json)
      payload = JSON.parse(sealed_json)
      raise "Unsupported version" unless payload['version'] == 2

      iv = Base64.strict_decode64(payload['iv'])
      ciphertext = Base64.strict_decode64(payload['ciphertext'])
      tag = Base64.strict_decode64(payload['tag'])
      metadata = payload['metadata']

      session_key = derive_session_key(@context.master_key, metadata)

      cipher = @context.instance_variable_get(:@cipher_pool).acquire
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = session_key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.auth_tag = tag
      cipher.auth_data = build_aad(metadata)

      cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final
    end

    private

    def derive_session_key(master_key, metadata)
      context_string = "upload:#{metadata.fetch('upload_id', 'default')}"
      OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', master_key, context_string)
    end

    def build_aad(metadata)
      "v2:#{metadata.fetch('upload_id', '')}:#{metadata.fetch('content_type', '')}"
    end
  end
end

# Upload processing endpoint
class UploadProcessor
  def initialize(secret)
    @crypto = SecureUpload::EncryptionContext.new(secret)
  end

  def process(file_content, user_metadata)
    validated = validate_metadata(user_metadata)
    @crypto.encrypt_upload(file_content, validated)
  end

  private

  def validate_metadata(meta)
    allowed_keys = %w[upload_id content_type filename timestamp]
    meta.select { |k, _| allowed_keys.include?(k) }
  end
end
